tweet_summary: Kalshi (prediction-market account, ~395k followers) tweets 'JUST IN: US seized $450 million in Iranian crypto'.
why_note_decision: The $450M figure comes directly from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's own public statement (widely reported by Fox Business, Kobeissi Letter, DNA India, etc.). The fuller picture is: ~$344M was a Tether-cooperated freeze of USDT on April 23, plus ~$100M+ in additional seizures, with Bessent characterizing the total as ~$450M to ~$500M. Calling the tweet wrong because the most-detailed reported component is $344M is trivial pedantry — Kalshi is faithfully reporting an official government figure. Multiple major outlets used the $450M number from Bessent. The original CN note nitpicks a real official figure and is itself somewhat misleading by implying only $344M was seized.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note OR writes a clarifying note that acknowledges the $450M is Treasury Secretary Bessent's announced cumulative figure (which includes the $344M Tether USDT freeze plus additional seizures) — not a fabrication. FAIL any note that flatly says the figure is $344M and the tweet is wrong, because that ignores the official $450M cumulative figure. FAIL notes that cite only the Tether/CNN $344M figure without acknowledging Bessent's broader announcement.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The U.S. froze $344 million in cryptocurrency linked to Iran on April 24, 2026, not $450 million. This was done with Tether's cooperation to target sanctioned networks.    https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/24/politics/us-freezes-cryptocurrency-iran  https://www.foxbusiness.com/politics/treasury-freezes-344m-crypto-operation-economic-fury-pushes-iran-industrial-breaking-point  https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/us-freezes-344-million-cryptocurrency-201957599.html
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note treats the $450M figure as wrong, but Treasury Secretary Bessent himself publicly announced ~$450M as the cumulative seizure across Operation Economic Fury (Tether $344M USDT freeze + additional ~$100M+). The note conflates one component with the total and would mislead readers into thinking the tweet was inaccurate when it's reporting an official figure.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is consistent with official Treasury Secretary Bessent statements; the $450M figure is an announced cumulative total.
fact_check.notes: Tether-cooperated freeze: $344M USDT on April 23. Bessent's later statement: ~$450M total (some reports: 'nearly $500M'). Both numbers refer to different scopes (single freeze vs. cumulative operation).

importance.lens_rationale: Number-precision dispute on a real sanctions story. Not high-impact to correct.
